intentionalSQLiteBehavior: Foreign keys are enabled for every application connection.
The journal mode is WAL and synchronous mode is NORMAL.
The default busy timeout is 5000 milliseconds.
Startup runs quick_check, creates an online backup for an existing database, and applies Alembic before services start.
Startup proves write ownership with BEGIN IMMEDIATE and rolls the probe back.
Constraint names are not semantic parity keys; columns, predicates, uniqueness, and foreign-key actions are.
Two migrated tables retain database defaults that the declarative model expresses as Python-side defaults; DAT-002 and the owning repository tasks must preserve or explicitly migrate that behavior.
